description: This file implements a serializer for Pipecat frames using Protocol Buffers, including classes for message framing and serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: MessageFrame
classes.description: Data class for converting transport messages into Protobuf format.

classes.name: ProtobufFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for converting Pipecat frames to/from Protocol Buffer format, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Frame object into Protocol Buffer binary format.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes Protocol Buffer binary data into a Frame object.
